translation: Now I can sum it up in one word: rub the jaw to clear the accumulation of the six yang on the head; the accumulation of the six yin in the lower part rises from the feet; next, rub the perineum to free and open the legs and hips, as a plan for aftercare; and in the end it still returns to the jaw. It is easy and simple, easy to know and easy to follow. Although I have now tried it on my body and obtained effect, I truly did not expect it to reach such an extreme.
